name: sdd-tdd-bridge
description: OpenSpec-Superpowers bridge plugin — main Agent orchestrates 4 stage Skills (load-context / planning / spec-compliance-check / dual-verify), deterministic checks for OpenSpec artifact format, Git Hooks for commit message, dual verification (OpenSpec verify + Superpowers verification) before archive. Connects OpenSpec (what to do) with Superpowers (how to do) with strong validation.
